title: Photo-based room previews versus 3D/AR viewers
description: A photo-based room preview combines a room image with a product image to produce an illustrative result. A 3D/AR workflow uses a 3D representation and, for.
answer: A photo-based room preview combines a room image with a product image to produce an illustrative result. A 3D/AR workflow uses a 3D representation and, for camera-based AR, a live camera view. Choose based on whether you need a visual composition or an interactive 3D experience.
body:
Compare the job each workflow does

Photo previews and 3D/AR workflows
QuestionPhoto-based preview3D/AR viewer
InputRoom photograph and product imageA 3D representation of the product
OutputGenerated still image of an illustrative placementInteractive 3D scene or camera-based AR view
EvaluationRecognisable item, composition and appearanceModel quality, interaction, device support and calibration
MeasurementsCheck product dimensions separatelyCheck the tool’s calibration and measurement claims separately

This is a comparison of workflow categories, not a feature audit of named competitors. Individual products can combine capabilities; verify each provider’s current documentation before choosing.

What Room Refresh does

Room Refresh is a Shopify app for furniture and home-decor merchants. Shoppers upload a room photo and generate a preview of a product in that space, directly from a product page.

AI-generated previews illustrate appearance and placement. They do not provide measured dimensions, guaranteed scale or a live camera-based AR view. Shoppers should check product measurements before buying.

Choose against a concrete customer question

Write down the decision your shoppers need help making. Test the same small selection of products and representative photos. Keep records of visual errors, mobile friction, privacy requirements and total usage cost. A visually appealing result is only one part of the evaluation.

See the product examples, setup requirements and plan pricing.
